title: Simulated search for Mozilla VPN pricing relies on fragmented third-party sources due to lack of on-site Product/Offer structured data
evidence: Simulated search for 'How much does Mozilla VPN cost?' returned fragmented third-party answers (Security.org, Apple App Store, VPN.com) with conflicting tier figures ($3.75/mo to $4.99/mo) rather than direct extraction from https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ where official pricing is published without Schema.org Offer markup.

suggested_action.summary: Expose official pricing and currency in Schema.org Product Offer markup.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Cross-check crawl-render-audit findings for this URL -- add Product/Offer JSON-LD to https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ to enable AI assistants to extract current, authoritative pricing directly from mozilla.org.
